title: Towards Reasoning in Large Language Models: A Survey
paper_type_zh: LLM 推理领域综述与决策地图
best_for_zh: 适合筛选推理论文，或区分数据、提示、训练、评测与解释主张的研究者。
one_line: This survey separates supervised reasoning, inference-time elicitation, self-improvement, evaluation, and interpretation into distinct claim types.
这篇综述把监督推理、推理时诱导、自改进、评测和解释拆成不同主张类型。
why: It prevents prompt gains, training effects, benchmark scores, and faithful-reasoning claims from being conflated.
inclusion_reason: A structured map of how LLM reasoning is elicited, trained, evaluated, and interpreted.

title: Problem
问题
html:
LLM “reasoning” results mix different interventions: training on worked solutions, eliciting latent behavior with prompts or examples, bootstrapping new traces, scoring answers on benchmarks, and interpreting fluent explanations. Without separating them, an inference-time prompt gain can be misreported as a trained reasoning capability or a faithful internal process.

This survey builds a decision map of the field: fully supervised methods, prompting and in-context learning, hybrid methods that combine generation with further training, evaluation benchmarks, and findings about what observed behavior supports. It helps readers identify the actual prompt, rationale, answer, training record, and metric behind each reasoning claim.

L4 facts: primary sources https://aclanthology.org/2023.findings-acl.67/ and https://arxiv.org/abs/2212.10403; Findings of ACL 2023; boundary: literature survey, not a new reasoning dataset or verifier; atlas value: routes training, elicitation, evaluation, and interpretation claims; companion paper list: https://github.com/jeffhj/LM-reasoning.

LLM“推理”结果混合了不同干预：用完整解答训练、通过提示或示例诱导已有行为、自举新轨迹、在 benchmark 上给答案打分，以及解释流畅说明。若不把它们分开，推理时的提示收益就可能被误写成训练得到的推理能力，甚至被误当成忠实的内部过程。

这篇综述建立了一张领域决策地图：全监督方法、提示与上下文学习、把生成与继续训练结合的混合方法、评测 benchmark，以及关于可观察行为能支持何种结论的研究发现。它帮助读者找出每项推理主张背后的实际提示、rationale、答案、训练记录和指标。

L4 事实：主要来源为 https://aclanthology.org/2023.findings-acl.67/ 和 https://arxiv.org/abs/2212.10403；Findings of ACL 2023；边界是文献综述，而非新推理数据集或验证器；图谱价值是路由训练、诱导、评测和解释主张；配套论文列表位于 https://github.com/jeffhj/LM-reasoning。

title: Core idea
核心思路
html:
The survey's contribution is a boundary-aware taxonomy that separates training reasoning, eliciting reasoning at inference time, self-improving with generated traces, measuring task performance, and interpreting model behavior. Chain-of-thought prompting and STaR therefore occupy different causal locations even if both produce rationales. Compared with method lists, this organization forces every result to name its data object, intervention point, feedback, and evaluation surface, which makes it a foundations card rather than evidence for one method.

Google Scholar citations: 1569（checked 2026-07-27；https://scholar.google.com/scholar_lookup?title=Towards+Reasoning+in+Large+Language+Models%3A+A+Survey&author=Jie+Huang&hl=en）

Open dataset: no. The survey releases no new training or evaluation dataset. Its companion repository at https://github.com/jeffhj/LM-reasoning is a curated literature/resource list; sizes, schemas, formats, licenses, and intended uses of cited datasets remain those of their primary releases.

综述的贡献是一套强调边界的 taxonomy，分别处理训练推理能力、在推理时诱导推理行为、使用生成轨迹进行自改进、测量任务表现和解释模型行为。因此，CoT prompting 和 STaR 即使都会产生 rationale，也位于不同的因果环节。与简单的方法列表相比，这种组织要求每个结果明确数据对象、干预位置、反馈和评测表面，使它成为基础类 Card，而不是某一种方法的证据。

Google Scholar 引用数：1569（查询于 2026-07-27；https://scholar.google.com/scholar_lookup?title=Towards+Reasoning+in+Large+Language+Models%3A+A+Survey&author=Jie+Huang&hl=en）

开源数据：没有。综述没有发布新的训练或评测数据集。配套仓库 https://github.com/jeffhj/LM-reasoning 是整理后的文献与资源列表；被引数据集的规模、schema、格式、许可证和用途仍以各自主发布为准。

title: Method
方法
html:
1. Collect primary claims. Input: papers on language-model reasoning available through the survey period. Operation: record the task, model, prompt or training data, generated rationale/answer, feedback, and metric. Output: comparable claim records. Check: do not merge results with different models or evaluation protocols.
  1. Route supervised methods. Input: examples with annotated answers, derivations, explanations, or programs. Operation: group methods by how those targets train the model. Output: a map of supervised reasoning data and consumers. Check: distinguish answer-only labels from process supervision.
  1. Route prompting methods. Input: instructions, demonstrations, decompositions, working-memory prompts, and tool prompts used at inference time. Operation: classify zero/few-shot and in-context elicitation methods. Output: a map of inference-time interventions. Check: a prompt gain does not by itself show parameter learning.
  1. Route hybrid methods. Input: model-generated rationales or answers plus a selection signal. Operation: organize self-training, bootstrapping, and iterative generation-training loops. Output: a map from generated records to later training. Check: identify the trace author, acceptance rule, and whether intermediate steps are verified.
  1. Separate evaluation and interpretation. Input: benchmarks, task accuracy, analyses, and qualitative chains. Operation: classify what is measured and what conclusions are drawn. Output: a decision map for reading primary papers. Check: verify contamination, prompt/model versions, and whether fluent explanations support faithfulness claims.

1. 收集主张。 输入是综述时间范围内的语言模型推理论文。记录任务、模型、提示或训练数据、生成的 rationale 或答案、反馈和指标，产出可比较的主张记录。不能合并模型或评测协议不同的结果。
  1. 路由监督方法。 输入是带答案、推导、解释或程序标注的样本。按照这些目标如何训练模型进行分组，产出监督推理数据及其消费者地图。检查答案级标签和过程监督是否被明确区分。
  1. 路由提示方法。 输入是在推理时使用的指令、示范、分解、草稿和工具提示。分类零样本、少样本与上下文诱导方法，产出推理时干预地图。提示带来的收益本身不能证明参数已经学会推理。
  1. 路由混合方法。 输入是模型生成的 rationale 或答案以及筛选信号。整理自训练、自举和迭代生成—训练循环，产出从生成记录到后续训练的地图。检查轨迹作者、接纳规则以及中间步骤是否经过验证。
  1. 分开评测与解释。 输入是 benchmark、任务准确率、分析和定性推理链。分类测量对象与所得结论，产出主论文阅读决策图。检查污染、提示和模型版本，以及流畅解释能否支持忠实性主张。

title: Evidence
证据
html:
Method coverage. The survey places supervised fine-tuning, prompting and in-context learning, and hybrid self-improvement in separate branches, then connects them to reasoning evaluation and analysis. This breadth supports the taxonomy as a routing tool; it is not a controlled comparison showing one branch is superior.

Interpretation boundary. Across the literature synthesis, task accuracy and fluent chains are treated as observations whose mechanism and faithfulness require separate analysis. That distinction is the survey's decisive evidence for cautious reading, but numerical claims about a particular model, dataset, or benchmark must still be verified in the cited primary paper.

方法覆盖。 综述把监督微调、提示与上下文学习、混合自改进放在不同分支，再把它们连接到推理评测和分析。这样的覆盖支持 taxonomy 作为路由工具，但不是证明某一分支更优的受控比较。

解释边界。 在文献综合中，任务准确率和流畅推理链都被视为观察结果，其机制和忠实性需要单独分析。这一区分是综述支持谨慎阅读的关键证据；关于特定模型、数据集或 benchmark 的数值仍须在被引主论文中核验。

title: Novelty
新意
html: Earlier overviews commonly list reasoning tasks and methods without preserving where an intervention acts. This survey connects fully supervised, prompting, and hybrid branches to evaluation and interpretation, so a rationale can be recognized as training data, an inference artifact, or evidence depending on context. It introduces no new reasoning algorithm or benchmark; the novelty is the boundary-aware map and its synthesis of what observed LLM behavior does and does not establish. That map became a useful snapshot of the field through roughly 2022–2023.
较早的概览常列出推理任务和方法，却没有保留干预发生的位置。这篇综述把全监督、提示和混合方法连接到评测与解释，因此同一类 rationale 可以根据上下文被识别为训练数据、推理时产物或证据。它没有提出新的推理算法或 benchmark；新意在于强调边界的地图，以及对可观察 LLM 行为能够和不能够证明什么的综合。该地图构成了截至约 2022 至 2023 年的领域快照。

title: Limitations
局限
html:
• Time-bounded coverage. The map largely reflects literature available through 2022–2023 and misses later verifier, test-time compute, and reasoning-model developments; use the repository and newer primary work to update it.
  • Taxonomy versus causality. Placing methods in a category does not make their experiments comparable or identify why a score changed; inspect matched models, data, prompts, and protocols.
  • Reasoning observability. Correct answers and coherent chains do not prove faithful internal reasoning; require process checks or causal analysis when that distinction matters.

• 覆盖受时间限制。 地图主要反映 2022 至 2023 年前后的文献，缺少后来关于验证器、测试时计算和推理模型的发展；应通过配套仓库和更新的主论文补充。
  • taxonomy 不等于因果。 把方法放进同一类别，并不会让实验自动可比，也不能说明分数为何变化；需检查配置匹配的模型、数据、提示和协议。
  • 推理不可直接观察。 答案正确和推理链连贯不能证明内部推理忠实；若该区别重要，需要过程检查或因果分析。

title: Usefulness
用途
html: Use the survey when screening a reasoning paper or planning a literature review. Supply the paper's prompts, training records, generated traces, feedback, and metrics; assign each to training, inference-time elicitation, self-improvement, evaluation, or interpretation, and output a claim-evidence table. Success means the paper can be described without using “reasoning” as an unexplained umbrella term. Do not use this 2023 snapshot as a complete taxonomy of later reasoning models or as evidence for a particular score.
筛选推理论文或规划文献综述时，可以使用这张地图。输入论文中的提示、训练记录、生成轨迹、反馈和指标，把它们分别归入训练、推理时诱导、自改进、评测或解释，并输出主张—证据表。成功标准是无需把“推理”当成没有解释的总括词，也能准确描述论文。不能把这份 2023 年快照当成后来推理模型的完整 taxonomy，也不能用它证明某个具体分数。

title: Reading notes
阅读笔记
html:
1. Keep: training, inference-time elicitation, self-improvement, evaluation, and interpretation are different claim types.
  2. Route first: identify whether a rationale is supervision, a generated artifact, or evidence.
  3. Record: model, prompt, data/trace author, selection signal, benchmark, and metric for every result.
  4. Do not infer: a benchmark gain or fluent chain identifies the underlying reasoning mechanism or faithfulness.
  5. Audit first: primary-source protocol, contamination, evaluator dependence, and post-2023 literature coverage.

1. 应记住： 训练、推理时诱导、自改进、评测和解释属于不同类型的主张。
  2. 先做路由： 明确 rationale 是监督数据、生成产物还是证据。
  3. 必须记录： 每项结果对应的模型、提示、数据或轨迹作者、筛选信号、benchmark 和指标。
  4. 不能推出： benchmark 收益或流畅推理链不能识别底层推理机制，也不能证明忠实性。
  5. 扩展前审计： 主来源协议、污染、评判者依赖以及 2023 年后的文献覆盖。
